project_title: AURELIA Interiors - High-End Editorial Interior Design Platform & Studio

art_direction.theme: Warm & Elegant Editorial Architectural Craft (Warm Light Theme)

typography.headline_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond (Serif, High Elegance, Tight Tracking)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Manrope (Clean Humanist Sans, High Legibility)
typography.accent_mono: JetBrains Mono (For Specs, Admin Codes, Badges, Prices)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug
hierarchy.eyebrow: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-semibold text-brass_gold

art_direction.logo_mark: Original Brass Arch Monogram SVG logo mark representing 'Anweshan Infra'. An arched architectural vault motif crafted with brushed brass gradient strokes and elegant serif wordmark.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous editorial spacing (2x-3x typical whitespace), asymmetric Swiss-grid cards, padded containers (p-6 to p-12) to prevent text/border collisions.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Tetris Grid for Design Ideas & Services (col-span-full, col-span-8, col-span-4, col-span-2 fillers) with staggered Framer Motion entrance animations.
layout_and_spacing.header_navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/85 border-b border-[#E6DEC8]/60, featuring AURELIA SVG arch logo, nav links (Services, Design Ideas, How It Works, Contact), Direct Call button, WhatsApp primary CTA, and subtle Admin Entrance link.
layout_and_spacing.sticky_mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile viewports (<768px) with direct 1-tap Call button (Phone icon + 'Call Studio') and WhatsApp button (WhatsApp icon + 'Quick Chat'). High contrast brass/espresso styling.

key_features_and_user_flows.hero_section: Kinetic luxury hero with signature line-by-line masked headline reveal, full-width high-res architectural ambient background with soft gradient overlay (bg-black/30), interactive Quick Project Filter chip buttons, 1-tap WhatsApp consultation CTA & direct phone call button, plus smooth scroll indicator.
key_features_and_user_flows.services_section: Interactive catalog of services: Home Interior Transformation, Luxury Shop & Retail Fitting, and Custom Furniture & Woodwork Assessment. Each service card shows price tag (editable in admin), detailed scope, estimated timeline, icon+label for easy low-literacy understanding, and a direct 'Enquire for This Service' button opening pre-filled WhatsApp/Form modal.
key_features_and_user_flows.design_ideas_gallery: Filterable gallery (All, Homes, Shops, Furniture) displaying curated real interior designs with arch-clipped images, hover zoom micro-interactions, room specs, material highlights, and direct 'Save Idea' or 'Ask About This Design' drawer.
key_features_and_user_flows.interactive_furniture_assessment_tool: Visual multi-step estimator tool allowing clients (or low-literacy users) to tap visual cards (e.g., Sofa Repair, Wardrobe Polish, Wood Re-upholstery) to calculate instant rough price estimates and click 1-tap WhatsApp to send the assessment.
key_features_and_user_flows.how_it_works: Simple 4-step visually directed process (1. Tap WhatsApp / Call -> 2. Free Site/Furniture Visit -> 3. 3D Idea & Fixed Quote -> 4. Execution & Handover). Clear numbers, icon badges, and simple language.
key_features_and_user_flows.contact_and_enquiry_section: Comprehensive contact suite featuring direct WhatsApp button, 1-tap Phone Call button, Instagram direct profile link, studio location address with interactive map preview, and a simple 4-input Enquiry Form (Name, Phone, Service Choice, Message). Submissions are saved locally/backend for admin review with instant Sonner toast notification.
key_features_and_user_flows.hidden_admin_portal: Accessible via /admin or footer link. Secured with password gate (default: 'aurelia2026'). Admin features: (1) Add/Edit/Delete Design Ideas with image upload/URL preview; (2) Edit Service Base Prices & Timelines dynamically; (3) Read, filter, and manage customer enquiries received from the public contact form.

motion_and_micro_interactions.smooth_scrolling: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for continuous weight and luxury momentum.
motion_and_micro_interactions.scroll_animations: Framer Motion staggered entrance for grid items, reveal-up transitions on text blocks.
motion_and_micro_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial text ticker with warm beige background (#F4EFE6), displaying values: 'ARCHITECTURAL RESIDENCES • BOUTIQUE STORES • CUSTOM FURNITURE RESTORATION • CRAFTED IN BRASS & MAHOGANY'.
motion_and_micro_interactions.image_frames: Arch-shaped image masks (rounded-t-full or asymmetric radius) paired with gentle scale (scale-105) on container hover.
motion_and_micro_interactions.buttons: Pill & Arch shaped primary CTAs with subtle brass glow box-shadow, gold border sheen, and magnetic hover feel.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, form field, card, filter tab, and modal trigger MUST feature a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building React JS files (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript .tsx files.
Maintain the strict Warm Light Theme (Cream #FDFBF7, Espresso #1A1412, Brass Gold #C59B27). No default blue/purple gradients.
Ensure all contact CTAs open real actions (WhatsApp link `https://wa.me/...`, Phone `tel:...`, Instagram `https://instagram.com/...`).
Keep the UI extremely accessible and icon+label heavy so first-time or low-literacy users can operate it seamlessly.
Build the complete hidden /admin route with password authentication gate, design idea manager, service price manager, and enquiry viewer.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements as specified in testing_attributes.
